answer: A quadratic stake-burning protocol imposes superlinear cost scaling on identity clusters. At each epoch dawn, every agent must burn stake proportional to n^2 to validate n aliases, creating insurmountable economic friction against coordinated floods. Honest nodes project trust through a prism of verifiable historical commitments, while an attacker's capital drains exponentially. Stake destruction acts as an unforgeable lantern exposing malicious swarms.
